Name: Halcyon Seed, The Golden Shard

Rarity/Attunement: No

"Reshape... Destroy?" - Aurelionite the First Creation

Description: A shard of pure celestial gold, the heart of Aurelionite. It hums warmly and beats softly like a real heart.

Effects: Whoever possess the seed has Aurelionite's loyalty and trust. Aurelionite can be summoned once and will obey your commands and intentions.
